key.name: overview-behavior
key.description: Keep the main gradient, use the original Shell theme, or use a custom gradient while overview is open. Takes priority over window interaction.

key.name: overview-colors
key.summary: Start and end colours for the overview gradient
key.description: Two colour strings including opacity, saved independently of the main and alternate gradients.

key.name: style-trigger
key.summary: Condition that triggers the alternate panel style
key.description: Use the alternate panel behavior for maximized windows or windows near the panel.

key.name: proximity-distance
key.description: Distance in pixels below the panel at which a window triggers the alternate style.

key.name: proximity-transition
key.summary: Transition the alternate style based on proximity
key.description: Gradually blend the alternate style as a window approaches the panel.

key.name: maximized-behavior
key.summary: Behavior when the style trigger is active
key.description: Determines what style to apply to the top bar when the selected window condition is met: keep the normal gradient, use the default theme, or apply a custom style.

key.name: content-shadows
key.description: Add subtle dark shadows to panel text, icons and workspace indicators while a gradient is shown.

key.name: colors
key.description: Lists all of the colours that are saved for the gradient of the top bar in a serialized rgba() format.

key.name: gradient-direction
key.description: The orientation of the gradient can either be "vertical" or "horizontal"

key.name: maximized-colors
key.summary: Array of the gradient colours for maximized windows
key.description: Lists all of the colours that are saved for the gradient of the top bar when a window is maximized.

key.name: maximized-gradient-direction
key.summary: The orientation of the gradient for maximized windows
key.description: The orientation of the gradient when a window is maximized.
